rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 米国の溶接管工場の主要な鋼材供給元がニューコア
relations.text_en: Nucor Steel is the principal U.S. supplier of steel coils to its welded pipe mills

source.label: Tenaris 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: For our welded pipe operations in the United States, a significant part of our requirements for steel coils is supplied by Nucor Steel, which is our principal supplier in the United States.

relations.text: 鋼材の主な仕入先の一社であり、電気部門の競合でもある
relations.text_en: Nucor is a primary steel supplier and an Electrical segment competitor

source.label: Atkore 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: Our primary suppliers of steel are Cleveland-Cliffs, Steel Dynamics and Nucor

relations.text: 鋼材の仕入先にニューコアを挙げる

source.label: Northwest Pipe 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our suppliers include Steel Dynamics, Inc., ArcelorMittal, Nucor Corporation

source.quote: In April 2024 we acquired Southwest Data Products, Inc.

relations.text: カリフォルニア・スチールの50%持分をニューコアに売却
relations.text_en: Sold its 50% stake in California Steel Industries to Nucor

source.label: Vale 20-F(2024年度)
source.quote: In December 2021, the Company entered into a binding agreement with Nucor Corporation ("Nucor") for the sale of its 50 % interest in CSI

relations.text: 買収前の子会社が工場をニューコアに売却し、補償をめぐり係争
relations.text_en: A pre-acquisition unit sold a plant to Nucor; Nucor sued for indemnification

source.label: AZZ 10-K(2026年2月期)
source.quote: Nucor subsequently filed a lawsuit against Precoat Metals for indemnification for breach of environmental representations and warranties made in the 2020 Agreement.

relations.text: 主な競合にニューコアを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Nucor among its principal competitors

source.label: Gerdau 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: The Company's principal competitors include Commercial Metals Company (CMC), Nucor Corporation, and Steel Dynamics Inc.

relations.text: 米国市場の主な競合にニューコアを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Nucor among principal U.S. competitors

source.label: Grupo Simec 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Our principal competitors in the U.S. market, depending on the product, included Nucor Corporation, Charter Steel, Steel Dynamics

relations.text: 9インチ以下の棒鋼の主な競合
relations.text_en: Principal competitor for bars up to 9 inches

source.label: Metallus 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For bar products up to 9-inch in diameter, domestic producers Steel Dynamics, Inc. and Nucor Corporation (in some cases up to 10-inch) are our principal competitors.

relations.text: 線材から一貫生産する競合としてニューコアを挙げる

source.label: Insteel 10-K(2026年9月期)
source.quote: Some of our competitors, such as Wire Mesh Corporation, Nucor Corporation and Oklahoma Steel and Wire, are vertically integrated companies

source.quote: We compete with a number of other manufacturers of metal components and engineered building systems for the building industry, which mainly include Nucor, BlueScope, McElroy, Metal Sales and Central States.
